$Comment: What the trees' Greater Table stat (MMO_Station_Bonus_Queue: Bulk Return, Generous Rite) pays at the Greater Disenchanting Table, on each queued piece it unmakes: named by Extensions/DisenchantingGreaterProgression.json alone, so the lesser table never rolls it. Like the other piece bonuses in Mmo_Disenchant_Talents it pays Essence of Life and a second void roll, never more of the return, so unmaking still always loses materials. Every number here is balance data; retune by shipping a same-id file from a pack loading after this one.

Rolls.$Comment: Bulk Return and Generous Rite, essence half: on each piece of the Greater Table's queue, the chance of one more Essence of Life.
Bulk Return and Generous Rite, find half: on each piece of the Greater Table's queue, the same chance the ritual rolls the luck-weighted Essence of the Void (Mmo_Disenchant_Void_Finds) again.
